This document uses matplotlib only. No raw HTML is emitted by Python.

```{python}
#| label: fig-inspect-line
#| fig-cap: Inspectable matplotlib line chart
#| fig-alt: Line chart with three labeled points
#| fig-align: center
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

fig = plt.figure()
ax = fig.subplots()
ax.plot(["alpha", "beta", "gamma"], [3, 8, 5], marker="o")
_ = ax.set_title("Matplotlib through uv-python")
_ = ax.set_ylabel("value")
```

The rendered figure is referenced as @fig-inspect-line.

```{python}
#| fig-cap:
#|   - First inspect multi-figure
#|   - Second inspect multi-figure
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

first = plt.figure()
ax = first.subplots()
ax.bar(["A", "B", "C"], [1, 4, 2])
_ = ax.set_title("Bar chart")

second = plt.figure()
ax = second.subplots()
ax.scatter([1, 2, 3, 4], [4, 2, 5, 3])
_ = ax.set_title("Scatter chart")
```
